# Validate declarative option metadata (new helper + tests)

## Summary

Core has no CSV pipeline, JSON schema, or graph exporter (those are Main Street concerns). The TCE analogue of the original validator/schema child is a declarative `validateStorylineOptions()` helper in the core module that validates programmatically registered/compiled options, exported from `@story-line` and wired into the docs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Static validation.** Reject negative or zero costs; reject conditions with unknown field or op; reject non-numeric value; reject negative extra effect values; reject dangling conditional successors (rule targeting an id not present... at minimum structurally valid).
- **Registered options validated.** The helper validates programmatically registered options, not only compiled CSV rows.
- **Exported API.** `validateStorylineOptions()` is exported from `src/story-line/index.ts` and documented in `docs/core-engine/story-line.md`.
- **Shipped content.** All existing CSV encodings and Gym fixtures still compile; no shipped content uses the new fields.
- **Fixture tests.** Unit tests cover each broken-data class.

## Key Files

- `src/story-line/validate.ts` — new declarative validation helper.
- `src/story-line/index.ts` — export `validateStorylineOptions`.
- `src/story-line/types.ts` — types consumed by the validator.
- `tests/story-line/validate.test.ts` — broken fixtures per rule.

## Deliverables

- Updated validator with new checks.
- Unit tests with broken fixtures.

## Dependencies

- C1 (model extension).
- C4 (conditional successor semantics).

## Provenance

Refiled from `MS-0MURO2D6F002WM4Y` and adapted to core (no schema/graph in TCE; those stay Main Street concerns).
data.title: Validate declarative option metadata in core

# Update documentation for extended option model

## Summary

Document the new declarative fields and their resolution semantics in the canonical core docs: `docs/core-engine/story-line.md` and `docs/DEVELOPER.md`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Documentation.** `docs/core-engine/story-line.md` documents the extended `StorylineOption` fields `cost`, `extraEffect`, `conditionalSuccessors` with examples; resolution lifecycle documented.
- **Resolution lifecycle.** The lifecycle section documents the full path: draw-time condition and cost filtering, then policy effect, cost payment, extra effect, and successor precedence.
- **Seam and authoring docs.** `docs/DEVELOPER.md` note (near the `@story-line` alias table) confirms the new semantics are programmatic via `registerStorylineOptions`, not CSV-authored; the adapter contract documents the optional `applyResourceDelta` seam.
- **Gym demo.** `docs/core-engine/story-line.md` Gym section notes the demo is unchanged (no new semantics in shipped fixtures).
- **Docs-consistency test passes.** Cross-references and doc-drift checks remain green.

## Key Files

- `docs/core-engine/story-line.md`
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` (alias table + module reference)
- `src/story-line/resolve.ts` and `src/story-line/compile.ts` — JSDoc migration notes.

## Deliverables

- Updated documentation files.
- Passing doc-drift/reference checks.

## Dependencies

- All implementation features complete (C3, C4, C5).

## Provenance

Refiled from `MS-0MURO34NC003D1TV` (part of `MS-0MUNB58TK0025CB9`, deleted after refile).
